title: Send Field Notes for its first Google Play review via a closed testing release
blocked_by: The owner merging draft PR #306 (CHANGELOG.md 1.0.0 section): the release job refuses a final v1.0.0 tag without a dated 1.0.0 section.

completion_criteria.text: Google has approved the first review: the Play Console app list no longer shows App status Draft, and the Internal testing page shows no temporary app name.
completion_criteria.check: Play Console > All apps: Field Notes App status is not Draft; Test and release > Internal testing shows no 'Temporary app name' line

completion_criteria.text: Tag uploads roll out without a manual click: the PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS repository variable is deleted.
completion_criteria.check: gh variable list -R SatanshuMishra/field-notes prints no PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS line

artifacts.label: Play publishing guide (tracks, variables, one-time setup)
Release workflow with the play upload job
Settings, About and updates run home
Settings, About and in-app updates pull request (merged 5be3c040)

spine.active_goal: After the settings, About and in-app updates build (run home ~/.mitosis/field-notes/settings-about-updates) ships, merges and is released with a tag, publish a closed testing (Alpha) release in Play Console and send the app for Google's first review, so the temporary name 'dev.satanshumishra.field_notes (unreviewed)' becomes "Field Notes" and the app stops being a Draft app. The owner asked for this on 2026-10-11 as the follow-on step to that release.
spine.next_step: After the owner merges PR #306, push the v1.0.0 tag on the merged origin/main commit without touching the owner's checkout (the owner already said "v1.0.0. Go." on 2026-10-12), then read the release workflow once (macos, windows, android, release, play). The final tag lands as a draft on Closed testing (Alpha); preview and confirm it, then the owner clicks Send for review in Publishing overview. After approval, confirm the name and delete PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS.
spine.last_session: 2026-10-12: the owner set the Ed25519 update signing key (secret and variable) and said "v1.0.0. Go." The v1.0.0 tag needed a dated CHANGELOG 1.0.0 section, so the pipeline built it: round 1 loop (test pinned an empty Unreleased), fix-1, round 2 hard failure (gate could not prove a test-only fix), owner chose one more fix, fix-2 (check moved into a test-support file), round 3 green. Draft PR #306 opened and assigned.
